text:
I would not recommend this clinic based on my recent experience.
My family has been coming here for a long time. I have three children, and we've always trusted the dentists here. I've even recommended this clinic to friends because the dentists have always been professional and kind.
Unfortunately, my experience with the receptionist today was extremely disappointing.

You shouldn't go here. Go somewhere else. I usually use their services all the time. I have three children, and my friends also use them. I've even recommended them to people. The dentists are good, but the person answering the phone... please change them.

Today I called to make an appointment… the person who answered the phone today was terrible. I even had to call back to ask for their name because it was so unpleasant. Their attitude was awful.

They started by saying, "If you want an appointment at 10 am, we're not available... you have to book a month in advance for 10 am." *The employee actually said this... I got their name... Aomsin.*

I wanted to schedule another appointment for my child's teeth cleaning because the dentist didn't remove all the stains the previous week. But the employee responded, "What are you doing, ma'am? If your child's teeth still have stains from the last cleaning, do you need to clean them again, ma'am?" That was it. I was so annoyed. If they had spoken nicely and said, "You'll have to come back another time," or given other suggestions, I wouldn't have minded at all.

I have the money... I wasn't asking for it for free. I'm very disappointed, to be honest. I'm not someone who makes a fuss about things.
